Roughly 37% of Uzbekistan's total land area on a fraction of its population. Sits directly on the Aral Sea's Uzbek shore (material survey §0, §2.3) — the stranded former fishing port of Muynak is here. Drawable as one ordinary first-order unit under this project's whole-subdivision rule; the open question is political weight, not border geometry — the same category of author decision as Tuva in the Russia map-data package.
